extension: committed raw-record preview v1; final CAPDDR2 output contract unchanged
opt_in: Only a start request with top-level preview:true enables preview events for that finite job. Missing or false never emits preview, preserving existing strict v2 clients. Other types are rejected; plan fields are unchanged. CapturePage explicitly opts in.

preview_capability.preview_available: boolean: actual SG+committed capability and INFO ioctl; explicit fixture is allowed only with synthetic=true

event.job_id: opaque service job_id, same as start/status
event.generation: nonzero decimal uint64 string from actual capture_id; explicit fixture uses its own monotonic generation
event.frame_seq: positive integer, strictly increases within job/generation
event.first_record: uint32 original index of first record
event.ppr: integer 1..4096 from explicit user-confirmed capture request; analysis metadata, not hardware setting
event.hardware_confirmed: true only for the real ioctl backend
event.synthetic: false only for adc_unconfirmed; true for both test sources
event.source_flags: uint32 source flag bit0 TEST, other bits zero; fixture explicitly emulates TEST
event.validity_flags: requires COMMITTED=1, RECORDS_VALID=2, SOURCE_VERIFIED=8, CRC32=16; JOB_COMPLETE=4 optional
event.raw_base64: canonical base64 of exactly record_count*32 unmodified little-endian raw record bytes
event.crc32: uint32 IEEE CRC32 of decoded raw bytes only, same polynomial/initial/final convention as CAPDDR2/zlib.crc32
event.dropped_preview_records: records skipped since the preceding fully written preview frame; preview-only, never dropped raw-file records

record_layout: <QQhhhHII: index@0 tick@8 CH1/CH2/CH3 int16@16/18/20 flags@22 speed_period_ticks@24 speed_edge_count@28. Original flags bits0..4 remain unchanged; source is separate metadata.
record_validation: index=first_record+i, ADC valid bit0=1, no flags outside0x1f; period-valid bit1 implies positive period and no timeout bit2. Timestamp step=clock_hz/sample_rate_hz; tick-index*step anchor constant within generation and no uint64 overflow. CRC and actual source verification must pass before forwarding.
identity: The client must first compare the successful start response plan with its own original start request. Every frame, including the first, must match that confirmed plan's sample_rate_hz/pulses_per_rev/requested_records and actual backend source policy. job_id+generation+source+hardware_confirmed+synthetic+source_flags+sample_rate_hz+clock_hz+ppr+adc_range_uv+channel_map+record_bytes+requested_records are immutable within one live job. Missing/unknown/duplicate fields or wrong types reject the frame. A metadata/generation/source change quarantines preview for that job, while final raw capture can continue independently.
sequence: Reject duplicate/out-of-order frame_seq or first_record below the last accepted end; never append overlapping data twice. Later first_record above the accepted end is a visible gap. Client/model compute the observed gap independently, taking max with dropped_preview_records rather than double-counting.
backpressure: The capture worker never writes stdout directly: bounded control-response FIFO plus latest job-status and latest-preview slots. A dedicated nonblocking writer completes an in-flight JSONL frame before selecting the newest queued preview. Replaced previews are dropped, their skipped record interval is explicit. The driver and full raw-file acquisition remain unaffected.

signals.CaptureClient: liveFrame(const QJsonObject&), existing jobUpdated(const QJsonObject&) remains
signals.CapturePage: liveFrame(const QJsonObject&), captureState(const QJsonObject&), existing captureReady(QString)/statusChanged(QString) remain
signals.CapturePage_public: cancelCurrent() supports external window shutdown/cancel; no direct driver or hardware action

preview_rejection: Invalid preview data is not displayed. Emit a preview_error on captureState/job status; do not silently substitute fixture data or mark a final capture failed merely because a display frame was dropped. Final capture still undergoes independent full counts/index/ticks/CRC/loader verification.
ui_memory: Renderer retains at most a 2-second bounded window, marks observed gaps as NaN, and must not append preview losses to the final CAPDDR2 dropped_records field.
